text:
[LSER.13.3] **The author never names a backing structure.** The
compiler reads every observation line, groups triples by
compatible backings, coalesces shared backings, rejects
provably-empty cells, and picks structures that cover every
triple at the lowest total state cost. The matrix in
[LSER.18.1] is the backing catalogue; the spec surface stays
stable as the catalogue grows.
